quests.goal: Arrive in the muster hall under Harrowgate and try every way out of it: the loft stair, the cellar hatch, the grating over the cellar ladder and the stores stair, each barred until the muster falls.
Put down the dead levy when it falls in on the hall floor, so the bars on the loft stair, the cellar hatch and the stores stair come up.
Drop into the cellar and take the levy's roll, come back the long way round by the stores, pull the lever in the hall that raises the grating over the cellar ladder, and lay the roll in the loft.
